name: Website Previous & Next Products
description: Website Previous & Next Product Navigation improves the Odoo eCommerce browsing experience by adding direct previous and next product links to every eligible product detail page. Customers can continue exploring products in the current shop order without repeatedly returning to the product listing page. The module includes three professional navigation styles and preserves the active product category while moving between products.
summary: Website Previous & Next Product Navigation improves Odoo eCommerce product discovery by allowing customers to browse directly between product detail pages. It removes the need to repeatedly return to the shop page and provides a faster, smoother, and more engaging online shopping experience. The module offers three responsive navigation designs, including product labels, compact buttons, and visual product cards with thumbnail images. Administrators can enable the feature and select the preferred layout directly from the INKERP configuration settings. Navigation follows the configured website product sorting order, supports category-based browsing, and considers only products available on the website. This SEO-friendly Odoo website enhancement helps increase product exploration, reduce browsing friction, and encourage customers to view more products during each shopping session.

name: Signup Email Approval
description: Signup Email Approval protects the Odoo website registration process by requiring visitors to verify their email address before creating an account. The module sends a secure six-digit OTP to the entered email address and keeps the Sign Up button disabled until verification succeeds. Each verification code is time-limited, single-use, and protected against repeated incorrect attempts. Administrators can review every OTP request, monitor its status, resend codes, and track the user created from a successful verification.
summary: Signup Email Approval is an Odoo website signup security module that verifies new customer email addresses through a secure one-time password before account registration. It helps prevent fake accounts, mistyped email addresses, automated registrations, and registrations made with inaccessible email accounts. The module integrates directly with the standard Odoo signup page and provides a smooth OTP verification experience without redirecting visitors away from the registration form. Administrators receive a complete backend verification history containing OTP status, validity period, verification attempts, IP address, timestamps, and linked user information. With configurable activation, professional verification emails, OTP expiry management, resend functionality, and controlled signup access, this Odoo email verification app improves website account security while maintaining a simple registration experience. name: Veterinary Management
description: Veterinary Management is a comprehensive Odoo application designed for veterinary clinics, pet hospitals, and pet care centers to efficiently manage pet records and daily operations. The module allows users to maintain complete pet profiles with feeding schedules, medications, vaccinations, insurance details, bedtime routines, medical conditions, and customizable question-and-answer records. It supports creating appointments, boarding, services, and transportation requests while automatically generating invoices for chargeable activities. Users can easily generate professional PDF reports for pet details, appointments, boarding, services, and transportation, along with dedicated history reports for each service. The application also allows administrators to configure default invoice products and automatically apply predefined terms and conditions from the settings to appointments, boarding, services, transportation, and other related documents. With its centralized workflow and automation features, Veterinary Management helps streamline pet care, improve operational efficiency, and simplify clinic management.
summary: Veterinary Management is a complete Odoo solution designed to simplify the management of veterinary clinics, pet hospitals, and pet care centers. It provides an efficient workflow for managing pet appointments, boarding, services, and transportation from a single platform. The module also supports default terms and conditions that are automatically applied to appointments, boarding, services, transportation, and related documents. With its centralized workflow, automation features, and comprehensive reporting capabilities, Veterinary Management helps improve operational efficiency, reduce administrative work, and deliver better pet care services.
